sections.title: Potential hotel business
sections.body: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo’s 216 guestrooms and meetings capability could support a limited faculty, exhibitor or delegate lodging allocation and small ancillary meetings, if requested.
